**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
Unsafe or unsupported native attribute: {name}
```

```text
Unsafe URL attribute
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Remove the attribute (e.g. innerHTML is rejected); for URL attributes use a safe `http(s)` or relative value instead of a javascript: URL.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <a href="javascript:alert(1)">x</a>;
```

```tsx prefer
export const A = () => <a href="/help">x</a>;
```

## When it is reported

'Unsafe URL attribute' does not name the attribute.
